idp.purpose: Infrastructure and execution substrate: identity, capability registry, memory/context, model routing, Greenlane, trusted effect doors, measured capacity and runtime recovery.

genesis.purpose: Founder-facing instruction and agent coordination, FLOW lifecycle, governance protocols, independent reviews, Founder Surface/Otto, evidence-backed yield. Consumes actual IDP execution and receipts, never replaces the executor.

authority.founder: Only independently authenticated founder may create, activate, revoke or except fleet policy; agents cannot self-authorize.
authority.agents: Agents are governed subjects. They may propose but cannot self-certify or grant privileged rights.
authority.effects: Trusted runtime effect doors enforce permissions outside models; prompts, issue comments, Git authors and model ACKs never confer authority.
authority.precedence: Authenticated founder/protected governing policy decides permission. Independent time-stamped probes decide health. Historic documentation, simulated metrics and unmerged code are NOT operational evidence.

lifecycle: Instruction -> authenticated admission/context -> owned FLOW plan -> bounded execution -> independent verification -> deployed effect -> founder-visible operational yield. 600s with no real phase progress triggers bounded recovery; a PR, CI or agent ACK is not completion.
placement: Interactive development or emergency fallback, never mandatory production authority
Idle HTTP on an actually provisioned and measured node
Required always-on state within live OCI budgets

infrastructure.target: One OCI Always Free A1 4 OCPU/24GB VM, 200GB boot, k3s; TARGET NOT PROOF OF DEPLOYMENT.
infrastructure.recovery_candidate: E2.1.Micro was recorded as emergency recovery host; remeasure OCI availability/capacity before workload placement.
infrastructure.old_oke: OKE control plane entitlement lost 2026-10-29; OKE manifest paths or features.yaml defaults do not prove live services.
infrastructure.live_verdict: UNKNOWN until fresh independent caller/runtime probe

fleet_policy.upstream: OPA decision engine; OPAL is distribution candidate
fleet_policy.activation: Founder-authorised publication and actual PEP evidence required

session_contract.first_turn: Obtain trusted versioned model before planning and verify fresh authority, host and effects before privileged actions.
session_contract.missing_or_conflicting: UNKNOWN; safe diagnosis continues but affected privileged effects are withheld.
session_contract.freshness: This pack is decision/context, NOT current live OCI, service or model health.
